assetType: iOS/Android adaptive mobile app screen comp
surface: resident list compact inline status controls
prompt:
Edit the referenced mobile UI mockup. Preserve the overall design feeling, warm paper background, title/search/category rail, one-column resident cards, portrait placement, typography mood, colors, and bottom navigation.

Change only the resident card status controls:
- Make the five status controls much more compact and less visually dominant.
- Place all five controls in one single horizontal row inside each resident card: 위시, 우리 섬, 이사, 캠핑, 액자.
- Each visible icon button should be about 34-38 px visually, with enough surrounding spacing implying a 44pt/48dp tappable area.
- Remove the large two-row circular buttons from the previous comp.
- Keep selected states readable with a small filled chip, subtle checkmark, or colored ring, but do not make them oversized.
- Keep short labels under or beside each icon if they fit; labels should be compact and secondary.
- The resident portrait and resident name should regain visual priority over status controls.
- Keep the optional detail chevron on the right.

Constraints: no bottom sheet, no modal, no dense two-column grid, no instructional text blocks, no tiny inaccessible controls, no Nintendo logos. The screen must still clearly communicate direct status editing from the resident list.
